content: ग्राह {%a.%} (ही|{%f.%}) [ग्रह् भावे घञ्] Seizing, clutching; taking, holding, receiving <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-हः@} .²1 Seizing, grasping; हस्तग्राहं तु तं मत्वा <ls>Rām. 7. 34. 20</ls>. .²2 A crocodile, shark; रागग्राहवती <ls>Bh. 3. 45</ls>. .²3 A prisoner. .²4 Accepting. .²5 Understanding, knowledge. .²6 Persistence, importunity; तव मातुरसद्ग्राहं विद्म पूर्वं यथा श्रुतम् <ls>Rām. 2. 35. 18</ls>. .²7 Determination, resolve; मूढग्राहेणात्मनो यत्पीडया क्रियते तपः <ls>Bg. 17. 19</ls>. .²8 A disease. .²9 Any large fish or marine animal; जग्राहाजगरो ग्राहो भुजयोरुभयोर्बलात् <ls>Mb. 3. 178. 28</ls>; <ls>Ki. 13. 24</ls>. .²10 Morbid affection, disease. .²11 Beginning, undertaking. .²12 The handle (of a sword <ab>&c.</ab>). .²13 Paralysis. .{@-ही@} A female crocodile.
